zh-CN.ui.nativeOnly: 请在 Windows 桌面应用中操作。浏览器预览不会连接 Codex，也不会发送消息。
zh-CN.ui.incompatible: Desktop 接口无法确认兼容，已停止自动恢复
zh-CN.ui.reading: 正在读取本地 Desktop 状态…
zh-CN.ui.preview: 浏览器仅预览界面；不会连接 Codex 或发送消息。
zh-CN.ui.pendingAcceptance: 真实 resume 发送效果测试暂未执行；完整 Desktop 执行流及自然 5h 周期仍待验收。
zh-CN.ui.latestOnly: 仅对最新明确的 5h 中断发送恢复消息。
zh-CN.ui.noSessionsHelp: 打开 Codex Desktop 后重新检查。账号、来源或通信接口无法核实时，不会启用自动恢复。
zh-CN.ui.backgroundHelp: 关闭窗口后继续监听；重启应用后全部暂停。
zh-CN.ui.waitingFuture: 等待未来的 5h 额度中断
zh-CN.ui.deleteConfirm: 删除此 Watch？历史事件和 Attempt 记录会保留。
zh-CN.ui.noWatchesHelp: 从最近会话中选择一个会话并配置恢复消息。
zh-CN.ui.eventsHelp: 提交、执行确认、次数用尽与故障分别记录。发送结果未知时不重发。
zh-CN.ui.clearConfirm: 清理全部事件历史？Watch、Attempt 和诊断日志不会删除。
zh-CN.ui.noHistoryHelp: 运行中的状态变化和兼容故障会显示在这里。
zh-CN.ui.saved: 设置已保存。已有 Watch 的消息不会变化。
zh-CN.ui.defaultPromptHelp: 只用于新建 Watch；每个会话可单独修改。
zh-CN.ui.runtimePath: Runtime 路径（可选，仅用于版本诊断）
zh-CN.ui.notifications: 发生需要处理的故障时通知
zh-CN.ui.autoStart: 登录 Windows 后启动应用
zh-CN.ui.autoStartHelp: 自启动只启动应用，不恢复旧 Watch 授权。下一次启动后，需要手动重新开启。
zh-CN.ui.compatibilityHelp: 按实际接口能力、参数和响应检查兼容性，版本仅用于诊断。接口缺失、参数不兼容、多个端点、账号或上下文不明会阻断发送；发送结果不明确时不重发。恢复兼容后，需要显式重新开启 Watch。
zh-CN.ui.countHelp: 次数只在确认新 turn 进入执行后扣除。正常结束不触发下一条消息；周额度耗尽不处理。
zh-CN.ui.immediateConfirm: 当前额度已恢复；我确认按上面的消息开启并允许发送。
zh-CN.ui.reenableHelp: 将重新检查会话、兼容性和额度。如果最新中断符合条件且额度已恢复，会发送以下消息。
zh-CN.ui.unknownHelp: 未知发送结果会先核对，不会重新发送同一次中断。
zh-CN.ui.languageHelp: 语言选择立即保存；恢复消息保持原文。
zh-CN.ui.languagePreviewHelp: 浏览器预览可切换显示语言；此选择仅在本次预览中有效。

en.ui.nativeOnly: Use the Windows desktop app. The browser preview does not connect to Codex or send messages.
en.ui.incompatible: Desktop compatibility could not be verified. Auto resume is stopped.
en.ui.preview: Browser preview only. No connection to Codex or messages sent.
en.ui.pendingAcceptance: Live resume sending has not been tested. The full Desktop execution flow and natural 5h cycle still require acceptance.
en.ui.latestOnly: Resume messages are sent only for the latest confirmed 5h quota interruption.
en.ui.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or working directory
en.ui.noSessionsHelp: Open Codex Desktop and refresh. Auto resume stays disabled if the account, source, or interface cannot be verified.
en.ui.backgroundHelp: Monitoring continues when the window is closed. All Watches pause after the app restarts.
en.ui.waitingFuture: Waiting for a future 5h quota interruption
en.ui.deleteConfirm: Delete this Watch? History and Attempt records will be retained.
en.ui.noWatchesHelp: Select a recent session and configure its resume message.
en.ui.eventsHelp: Submissions, execution confirmation, exhausted counts, and faults are recorded separately. Unknown sending results are never retried.
en.ui.clearConfirm: Clear all event history? Watches, Attempts, and diagnostic logs will be retained.
en.ui.noHistoryHelp: State changes and compatibility faults will appear here.
en.ui.saved: Settings saved. Existing Watch messages are unchanged.
en.ui.defaultPromptHelp: Used only for new Watches. Each session can have its own message.
en.ui.notifications: Notify when a fault needs attention
en.ui.autoStart: Start the app when signing in to Windows
en.ui.autoStartHelp: Startup launches the app only. It does not restore Watch authorization. Re-enable Watches manually after the next launch.
en.ui.compatibilityHelp: Compatibility checks use actual interface capabilities, arguments, and responses; versions are diagnostic only. Missing interfaces, incompatible arguments, multiple endpoints, or an unknown account or context block sending. Uncertain send results are never retried. Explicitly re-enable Watches after compatibility is restored.
en.ui.countHelp: A count is deducted only after a new turn is confirmed executing. Normal completion does not trigger another message. Weekly quota exhaustion is not handled.
en.ui.immediateConfirm: Quota has recovered. I confirm enabling this Watch and allowing the message above to be sent.
en.ui.reenableHelp: The session, compatibility, and quota will be checked again. If the latest interruption qualifies and quota has recovered, the message below will be sent.
en.ui.unknownHelp: Unknown sending results will be checked first. The same interruption will not be sent again.
en.ui.languageHelp: Language is saved immediately. Resume messages stay verbatim.
en.ui.languagePreviewHelp: Switch the display language in this browser preview. The selection lasts for this preview only.
